## Description

Scheduled job deletes audio chunks after the tenant's retention period (default 30 days) unless a legal hold exists; transcripts/drafts kept with the signed note. Deletion recorded (counts, ranges) without PHI. Blob lifecycle rules as backstop.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Audio older than the retention period is deleted and the deletion is logged; held items are skipped.
- [ ] **AC2.** Evidence replay after deletion shows "Audio deleted per retention policy" while transcript evidence remains.
- [ ] **AC3.** Retention changes apply prospectively and are audited.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
